title: Real-Time Collaboration, Review & Multi-Device Sync
objective: Provide authorized coauthoring over the same comic project with role-aware edit permissions, page/panel/layer presence, review comments, explicit conflict handling, multi-device continuation and offline/reconnect recovery without creating a second canonical asset/provenance or source-domain ledger.
acceptance: Collaboration sessions preserve one stable SAA project/version identity and explicit participant/session identity.
Role-aware edit permissions explicitly authorize or reject project/page/panel/layer operations before mutation.
Presence and review-comment state remain collaboration metadata and do not become canonical Character, Scene, Dialogue, ARI, AAI or narrative truth.
Concurrent edit conflicts are explicit and deterministic; no last-writer-wins or silent conflict repair is inferred.
Multi-device continuation preserves project/version, history cursor, page/panel/layer identity and authorized participant state.
Offline/reconnect recovery uses explicit base/head lineage and fails stale or incompatible reconnection closed rather than silently rebasing.
Provider-off/local single-user operation remains valid and collaboration is not required for core authoring.
SAA-22 and later professional lettering/drawing/share/publication behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-21 owns collaboration coordination metadata only; canonical project edits still flow through governed SAA edit/history authority.
Collaboration cannot create duplicate asset/provenance, Character, Scene, Dialogue, AAI, narrative or source-domain ledgers.
No silent conflict resolution, silent rebase, fabricated permissions or automatic owner-truth mutation is allowed.
Collaboration remains optional; provider-off single-user operation must remain usable.
No advanced lettering/drawing, sharing/publication, external upload or final Creator integration authority is granted.
SAA-22 remains blocked until verified SAA-21 closeout.
next_action: Await a later explicit owner Continue before governed-starting SAA-21.
